mechanism: Quinidine inhibits CYP2D6, the primary metabolizer of deutetrabenazine, leading to increased deutetrabenazine exposure and enhanced risk of adverse effects including QT prolongation and arrhythmias.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, reduce deutetrabenazine dose by 25-50% and monitor ECG and QTc interval closely due to additive cardiac effects.
